history.content: found a box of old cassette tapes in my parents garage on the weekend. kind of weird going through them
That does sound a bit uncanny — like the past got physical for a moment. What was the weirdest part of it for you?
nah not uncanny really. more just nostalgic i guess. one of them had my dads handwriting on it, mixtape he made my mum back in like 1989 before they got married
That feels more nostalgic than uncanny — and his handwriting on a mixtape from before they married gives it a real time-capsule feel. Does it land more as warm, or more as a strange kind of tender?

warm definitely. we actually dug out the old player and put it on. song quality was rough but you could tell he picked every track on purpose. my mum went quiet halfway through, think she forgot he used to do stuff like that
That sounds warm in a really specific way — rough sound, but a lot of intention underneath it. Did it make you want to sit with it, or share it right away?

kind of wanted to sit with it. honestly made me a bit proud of them? like they've been together 35 years and theres proof right there that it started with him doing this dumb sweet thing. dont really see that side of them day to day
That feels like pride with a little tenderness in it — a kind of proof that their story has this sweet beginning. Does it feel more like pride, gratitude, or something softer than that?
bit of both i think. ripped a couple of the songs onto my phone so i wouldnt lose them. gonna put the actual tape somewhere safe too. glad i was the one who found it tbh
That sounds like a small, keeper kind of moment — you wanted to hold onto it, and be the one who found it. We can leave it there, or I can stay with what it connects to for you.
yeah lets leave it there. that was nice to get out actually. cheers
Yeah — glad it got to be said. Cheers, and you can bring me another small keeper whenever you like.
